title: The Quartermaster's Store
transcription:
The Quartermaster's
Store

There are snakes, snakes big as garden rakes,
At the store, at the store.
There are snakes, (snakes), snakes big
as garden rakes,
At the quartermaster's store.

Chorus:
My eyes are dim, I cannot see,
I have not got my specks with me.
I have not got my specks with me.

There are mice, mice running through the rice,
At the store, at the store.
There are mice, (mice), mice running
through the rice,
At the quartermaster's store.

Chorus

There are rats, rats, big as alley cats,
At the store, at the store.
There are rats, (rats), rats,
big as alley cats,
At the quartermaster's store.

Chorus
Extra verses can be added as desired.
